working_tree_semantics: The refinement was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Pre-existing user document edits were preserved. No files were staged, committed, or pushed.

todo_contract.scope: exact ROOT or SUBAGENT_TASK logical run
todo_contract.durability: advisory; intentionally lost on Host replacement
todo_contract.model_visible_result: bounded count/status acknowledgement without item text or artifact
todo_contract.strict_prefix: TODO changes never mutate BASE_SYSTEM, tools, or an installed message; ordinary canonical tool call/result facts append only

admission_and_settlement.root_finalizer: direct fast path, direct ACK confirmation, and queued exact confirmation share one shielded idempotent activation finalizer
admission_and_settlement.queued_confirmation: stable prepared candidate with FULL | NONE | CONFLICT stateless confirmation
admission_and_settlement.child_birth: revision-0 TODO run exists only after exact initial child admission FULL
admission_and_settlement.closing: Host close stops queued admission, drains active and pending settlement owners, installs any canonical FULL replacement, then closes each exact run at final revision plus one

post_review_closure.direct_admission_cancellation: After a direct admission FULL, cancellation during the shielded TODO finalizer drains the finalizer and exact turn interruption before cancellation is re-raised.
post_review_closure.close_pending_tokens: Host and child close join the exact runner and shielded result settlement first, then close_run mechanically rejects any ownerless retained token; there is no unbounded condition wait.
post_review_closure.queued_mutation_surface: The legacy caller-supplied consume_prompt_head mutation was physically removed. Production and retained tests use only prepared consume plus stateless FULL | NONE | CONFLICT confirmation.
post_review_closure.host_replacement_continuation: Plan review, Terminal observation, and external-result continuations bind an existing TODO run when present but remain available after Host-local TODO state is intentionally lost; the same-Host automatic successor path remains strict.

live_and_compaction_boundary.event_shape: one atomic full snapshot or CLOSED projection
live_and_compaction_boundary.initial_attach_and_gap: establish live baseline first, then replace from current Host owner inventory
live_and_compaction_boundary.round5b_retained_interface: read-only actionable pending/in_progress snapshot with UNTRUSTED_OBSERVATION trust

deterministic_verification.post_review_full_coverage: 737 tests passed in one clean run after closing the Host-replacement continuation finding; no failures, skips, or xfails were added.

non_goals: Round 5B compaction, summary, snapshot adoption, or context rebase
durable TODO relation, event, job, receipt, replay, or recovery
Plan workflow or hierarchical task-graph replacement
hidden TODO reminders or TODO compiler source
